fields.description: Master switch. When OFF, no standard haulage is added to Stock Entries and trips can close without cost settlement. Configure every account below BEFORE switching on.
fields.label: Enable Logistics Cost Capitalisation

fields.description: When ON, Force Close Trip is blocked on a dispatched trip until Finance has settled its trip costs (clearing balance = 0).
fields.label: Require Cost Settlement Before Trip Close

fields.description: Balance-sheet clearing account. EVERY trip cost (hauler invoice, driver expense claim, diesel issued, prepaid drawdown) is coded here, never straight to P&L. Drained by Stock Entry additional costs (capitalised) and the trip settlement JE.
fields.label: Logistics Cost Clearing Account

fields.description: Liability. Credited at trip settlement for third-party hauler freight not yet invoiced. The hauler's Purchase Invoice is later coded to this account to clear it.
fields.label: Freight Accrued (Hauliers) Account

fields.description: P&L. Share of trip cost attributable to kg returned to source / retained onboard / lost (IAS 2.16 abnormal cost).
fields.label: Unproductive Haulage Account

fields.description: P&L. Actual delivered-share cost minus standard haulage capitalised on receipts. Charged to the SOURCE outlet's Operations cost centre.
fields.label: Haulage Variance Account

fields.description: NGN per kg used only when a route is NOT in the Route Rate table below and the trip has no agreed rate. Leave 0 to add no haulage on unlisted routes.
fields.label: Fallback Standard Haulage Rate (per kg)

fields.description: Charged with unproductive haulage when the cause is 'HQ dispatch / planning call' (e.g. Head Office - Operations).
fields.label: HQ Operations Cost Center
Route Rate Table (From -> To outlet)
fields.description: Each drop uses the rate for its own route (source -> destination). If only the reverse route is listed, that rate is used. A rate entered on the trip itself (e.g. agreed third-party hauler rate) overrides this table for every drop on that trip.
